text:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — webinar promo schedule for next Tue (Apr 20). Goal: 400 live, 1.5k signups. Need X thread (3 tweets), LinkedIn long-form, LinkedIn short post, hero image + 30s clip. Who can take copy + asset coord? :calendar:

Jamal Rivera: I can own copy for X + LI short. Will draft two angle threads: 1) performance & cost benchmark narrative, 2) reliability/enterprise play.

Erin Patel: I'll handle hero image + clip. Need final copy by EOD Wed to get editing and captions done. What specs?

Maya Chen: Erin — hero: 1200x675 for X card, 1200x627 for LI feed, clip 1080x1080 mp4 <=15s (we can loop). Send originals to /shared/marketing/assets/webinar-apr20.

Leo Kim: For signups routing, confirm where leads go — HubSpot campaign "Webinar-Apr20"? Also need UTM params.

Sarah Novak: Confirming HubSpot. Use utm_source=social&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=webinar_apr20&utm_content={channel}_{variation} . I'll create the campaign and handle inbound routing to the SDR queue (sdr-inbound-webinar).

Jamal Rivera: Copy plan: Thread A (benchmark narrative) — 3 tweets: preview top stat, quick callout (latency & cost savings), CTA to register. Thread B (enterprise narrative) — trust + compliance + demo CTA. I'll post the drafts here by Tue noon.

Erin Patel: Also need slide of 3 benchmark visual shots for the LI long-form. I can mock those if Jamal shares the stats and sample phrasing.

Maya Chen: Jamal — can you add two headline variants for LI long (1: product-first technical, 2: customer-outcome)? We will A/B test in paid boost later but want organic signals now.

Jamal Rivera: Yep. Two headline variants per angle. Also adding fallback one-liner CTA for X if char budget tight.

Leo Kim: Small ask — include tracking pixel note for the landing page for webinar (we'll need to capture source + leadscore). Tagging @calendar-bot to add the webinar event to the promo calendar once assets are uploaded.

calendar-bot: Event "Webinar: Inference in Production" added to marketing calendar on Apr 20, 10:00 PDT. Reminder: assets due Apr 17 EOD.

Sarah Novak: Follow-up plan: SDRs will send 2-touch sequence — immediate thanks DM + resource, then 3-day follow-up with demo offer. I'll draft templates and post for ops review.

Maya Chen: Engagement followups — we'll use 4-hour window to reply to comments on X for first 24 hours, assign Leo and Jamal for first round, then rotate. Add quick reply templates: 
- "Thanks! Register here: <link>"
- "Sending you the deck — DM your email and I'll drop it."

Erin Patel: Asset checklist: hero, clip, 3 slides for LI, accessible alt text, 2 thumbnail variants. I'll upload originals + export versions.

Jamal Rivera: Also want to run a micro-eval: compare engagement between the benchmark thread and the enterprise thread on X. We'll tag posts with content tags so we can measure CTR -> signup conversion over 48 hours.

Maya Chen: Perfect — owners: Jamal (copy + A/B), Erin (assets), Sarah (lead routing + SDR templates), Leo (tracking + comment ops). I'll consolidate timelines in the sheet and ping again Wed morning. :thumbsup:
